title: Senior Receivable Specialist
jobDescription: At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet. Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place. About you and the role The Invoice to Cash, Navi Mumbai Collections Senior Receivable Specialist is responsible for the Collection work processes of Dow customers. This role acts as the first level support for Receivable Specialist, leads continuous work process improvements, works on corporate initiatives and implementations, delivers training, ensures compliance with internal and external controls, coordinates internal and external audit efforts, among other responsibilities. As a Senior Receivable Specialist, you will be responsible for Works closely with other sub-functions in the Invoice to Cash organization to deliver exceptional service to customers and maintain profitability for Dow. This role is integral to the success of the Company and business specific cash flow objectives as well as achieving key enterprise targets such as Percent Current Receivables and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO). This role has a strong interaction with finance, commercial, customer service, and DSS organizations. Main Responsibilities Acts as main customer point of contact for all accounts receivable activities. Follows up on leads near due and past due collection activities. Influences customer payment behaviors Provides in-depth customer account knowledge to other areas of the invoice to cash organization as an active member of account teams. Leads accounts receivable improvement projects specific to customer account activities. Acts as a focal point for ECC product testing. Manages account reconciliation including but not limited to offsets, sales adjustments, investigating and resolving discrepancies, resolving credit blocks, and processing returns. Collaborates with Credit, business partners and other invoice to cash teams including escalation. Utilizes payment receipt and handling work processes. Adheres to compliance requirements for SOX and Legal Additional activities, including but not limited to tax certificate updates, web portal review and update, document retrieval, and customer contact information updates. Predefined KPIs provides input into organizational priorities and performance metrics. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Management and Business Administration degrees is preferred. Able to work in flexible time arrangements to accommodate to time zone. Results oriented, sense of urgency, attention to details, organized, focused on priorities, driven with hands-on approach.
